title: epan: Enable ASN.1 constraints check
description:
Enable constraints check for ASN.1 dissectors.

The remaining dissectors camel, glow, gsm_map and inap needs
various improvements to the conformance file or asn2wrs.py.

Since `-C` is the default now, should the constrained versions of the integer functions in `packet-ber.h` be made `WS_DLL_PUBLIC`?
I'm not sure why they are not `WS_DLL_PUBLIC` already, looks like they where omitted in commit 1ebdb2e521ca0cbd7aeebd1c89b8a5cf6a4cc322.

I don't really love the idea that `-C` had its meaning flipped. Ideally I'd like to do something like "`-C` is now the default if you don't specify, but it has the same meaning (essentially no-op unless it's appears later than an option that turns off constraints.)", and add a new option to disable constraints.

Unfortunately, the natural choice to me would be `-C` enables constraints and `-c` disables them, but `-c` is already taken.
The plan is to remove `-C` completely to always enable constraints. Unfortunately I had some issues with a few dissectors so I had to postpone that plan.
I can flip this back and add it to all our CMakeLists.txt files if this makes life easier.
I think switching the default is good, I'm just not sure about reversing the meaning of `-C`. I would rather `-C` be essentially a no-op and there be a new option for no constraints.
Let's pick a different letter. What about `-N` for "No SIZE constraints"?
Sure, sounds good. And then either no-op or print a warning for `-C` similar to done with `-X` and `-T`.
Fix in !22584
